name: fitweb-gate-model-a
prompt: Image 1 is the STYLE and CAMERA reference: a premium architect's miniature scale model (a diorama) photographed in a bright studio on a seamless warm ivory background, seen from a high three-quarter isometric angle (about 35 degrees down, looking diagonally across the model), soft daylight from the upper left, gentle soft shadows, shallow tilt-shift depth of field, white and light-grey model base with engraved road and plot lines fading into the ivory page at the edges. Images 2 to 5 are real photographs of the main entrance gate of Forteasia Industrial Township. Build a new scale model in exactly the style, lighting, colours and camera angle of image 1, but showing this real gate, reproduced faithfully: two tall grey towers on either side of a wide entry road, the left tower wider, clad in vertical light-grey aluminium slats with a glazed corner window, the blue and red FIT logo on its face; the right tower slimmer with vertical slats and the red Forteasia logo; a long flat cantilevered roof beam spanning the full road between and beyond the towers, white face with a warm wooden soffit underneath, carrying the words FORTEASIA INDUSTRIAL TOWNSHIP in navy capital letters across its front; a low grey boundary wall either side; a few palm trees and slim flag poles with purple and pink flags beside the entry. Through the gate runs a smooth grey two-lane entry road with white lane markings and a small guard cabin with a boom barrier. Scene of activity in miniature, all as model pieces: a container truck driving out of the gate, a tipper truck waiting to drive in, a white pickup, a forklift and a few tiny workers in hi-vis vests near the cabin, small trees and neat lawn strips along the road; behind the gate inside the township, the edge of plots and one navy ribbed metal factory shed, and outside it the main road with soft green farmland strips fading into the ivory background. Wide 16:9 composition, the gate slightly right of centre with generous ivory space on the left and top so it blends into a web page, the whole model in sharp focus, ultra-detailed, crisp edges, photoreal miniature, premium and calm. No other text anywhere except the words on the gate beam and the two logos; no watermark, no frame, no people larger than miniature figures.
